card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS headings
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of an all-capitals heading or title, such as OF, AFTER, THE or part of a capitalized word. It fires where the heading is still going and more capitals should follow.

modes.label: Linking words in caps headings
modes.description: Small words like OF, AFTER, THE or ABOUT inside an upper-case title or table header.
modes.example: IT’S ALL<< ABOUT>> LIFE In the five short years since

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: Middle pieces of a long capitalized word or title phrase.
modes.example: TIMING OF MIS<<SED>> MAINTENANCE DOSE DOSING

card.writes: It promotes capitalized function words such as DOES, WHICH, BETWEEN and RETURN, so the heading continues in capitals.
card.plain: It notices that a heading is written in capital letters and expects the next word to be capitalized too.
